name: Saffron + Sand Lizard + Nutmeg fruit
indication_description:
This is indicated in-
  • Sexual debility
  • Loss of libido
  • Premature ejaculation
  • Fatigue
pharmacology_description: This is a unique preparation of Saffron (Crocus sativus), Nutmeg (Myristica fragrans) and other natural ingredients. It is a tonic to increase libido, helps retentive power, and maintains youthful vigour & vitality. It is effective in sexual debility, premature ejaculation and fatigue.
dosage_description: 1-2 tablet(s) to be taken with milk 2 hours before coitus or as prescribed by the physician.
side_effects_description: No significant side effect has been observed in proper dosage.
precautions_description: Keep out of reach of the children.
storage_conditions_description: Store at cool and dry place protect from light.
